name: Sagisawa Rui
source:
‘You’re easy to talk to,
it doesn’t feel as if we’ve only just met.’

Med student at the imperial university.
Working at a part-time job in between his studies, he is a calm med student. He is often reading in cafes or the library, and meets the heroine by coincidence. 

[From [url=https://riebakkari.wordpress.com/2015/10/11/the-scales-of-nil-admirari-introduction/]Rie's Otoge Blog[/url]]
